# Orb golden vectors

`orbs-golden.json` is the reference geometry for the nine thinking-orb states,
generated by the upstream [`thinking-orbs`](https://github.com/Jakubantalik/thinking-orbs)
library (spec version 1.0.0, source library 0.3.1).

It is vendored here so `test/orbs/orb_golden_test.dart` can verify that this
package's Dart port reproduces the upstream geometry exactly — 72 cases
(9 states x 2 size tiers x 4 timestamps), 11,288 dots and 341 lines, compared
dot by dot at a tolerance of 1e-4.

The file is excluded from the published package by `.pubignore`; it only needs
to exist for CI.

Upstream is MIT licensed; the full notice is in `orbs-golden.LICENSE.txt`.
